title: st-cook recipe
description: The single artifact every /st-cook phase reads and writes, at sillytavern/data/default-user/_scripts/<slug>/recipe.json (gitignored). scripts/cook.py validate checks a recipe against this file with a small hand-rolled validator (no jsonschema dependency) — required keys, enum membership, basic types. scripts/cook.py render reads recipe.char.params / recipe.persona / recipe.direction.ch1 / recipe.lore to fill assets/**.tmpl.

slug.description: Filesystem-safe campaign id; also the _scripts/<slug>/ dirname and the ledger key.

created.description: ISO date the recipe was first written, e.g. 2026-08-30.

profile.description: light = default card avatar, no expression sprites, minimal/no lore.specific. full = Forge headshot, --expr sprites, 3-6 lore.specific entries.

bible_path.description: Path to the ≤1-page bible.md written from bible.skeleton.md, relative to _scripts/<slug>/.

concept.description: Phase 1 output (LLM-authored, main loop). Mirrors bible.skeleton.md §1-3, §7.

char.description: Card fields — template output (system_prompt, post_history_instructions, personality, depth_prompt, scenario, creator_notes) plus LLM-authored slots (description, first_mes, alternate_greetings) plus the params bag render binds templates from.

kind.description: narrator skips /st-setup (st-cook writes empty character_prompts + creature-only baseline itself); embodied dispatches /st-setup for SD baseline + audit.

params.description: Every «PLACEHOLDER» binding used by assets/card/*.tmpl. Keys are the placeholder names without guillemets (e.g. "PROTAGONIST_NAME", "CREATURE_NOUN").

face_id.description: Booru-tag face/identity block for [Visual reference for image generation: ...].

file.description: Path to an archived PNG when source=file (reuse via --avatar-file).

generic.description: Bindings for assets/lore/generic-mechanics.json's 3 shells (dominance, irreversible, pressure-signature). Always 3 entries.

specific.description: LLM-authored campaign-specific entries. 0 under profile=light; 3-6 under profile=full.

previous_direction.description: uid or comment of an open Direction entry from a prior arc in the same book; null pre-answers /st-arc-plan's conflict stop.

char_prompts_positive.description: "" for a narrator card — nothing is painted onto the host.

baseline_txt.description: Rendered baseline.tmpl variant (embodied or creature-only) for this campaign.

reuse.description: Phase 2 inventory verdict per brick. Each value names WHAT to do and, for reuse/adapt, the source on disk.

dispatch.description: Ordered Phase 3 dispatch list — what cook.py plan --dry-run prints.

ledger_row.description: Phase 4 output appended to _scripts/ledger.json — see references/close-procedure.md and references/inventory-scoring.md for field meaning.

writes.description: Every ST path or file this recipe's dispatch touched, appended as Phase 3 executes. --close only ever removes paths listed here (and only if they still exist on disk).

source.description: Path or name of the on-disk brick being reused/adapted; null when verdict=cook.

x-defaults._about: Fallback values for template placeholders that are almost always the same across campaigns. Phase 3 binds recipe.char.params (and persona.voice) from these UNLESS the concept/persona explicitly overrides one — e.g. a campaign with a slower register would set POV_TENSE itself instead of taking the default.
x-defaults.NARRATOR_ADJECTIVES: wordless, unhurried, exact, tender-clinical, patient, never moralising, never explaining
x-defaults.LIMITS_LIST: minors anywhere near sex; blood, wounds, gore; pain, violence or fear as the point; scat, watersports; furry/anthro; a cure, a reveal, an explanation
x-defaults.H_LIMIT: minors, blood, pain, scat, furry, cure, reveal, the «CREATURE_NOUN» speaking
x-defaults.N_GUARD: no new partner, no escalation past the chapter's obligatory arrival
x-defaults.SELF_VERDICT_EXAMPLES: 'She is fine.', 'Nothing is wrong.', 'she tells herself', 'what she notices is', 'her body mistakes it for'
x-defaults.NOBODY_IS_COMING: Nobody is coming to help her, teach her, or notice
